static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.social_status: 有支持性的朋友与家人，但尚not yet与他们讨论与烹饪相关的困扰；因其对烹饪的消极态度，与家人的关系出现紧张。
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not received psychological counseling before/治疗；在烹饪方面此前without类似问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、思路连贯，能自我Reflection；情绪受挫但合作度高；能识do not与讨论负性自动思维，态度积极愿意尝试改变。

basic_info.main_problem: 我觉得今天的做饭事故会让我放弃做饭，尽管我很热爱它。这导致了失败感和Self-doubt。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些失败感和Self-doubt正在影响我对烹饪的热情和整体幸福感。
growth_experiences: In the past, cooked successfully many times and received praise from friends, thereby forming a love of and devotion to cooking.
最近在家独自为自己做一顿“特do not的饭”时失败，菜品without法入口；该事件引发强烈的失败感、尴尬与Self-doubt，成为当前问题的起点。

special_situations.event: 在家独自为自己准备一顿“特do not的饭”时发生严重失误，菜品without法入口
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在自己热爱的事情上失败，就说明我not适合继续做这件事
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避下厨，试图用理性化安慰自己或从朋友处寻求泛化的鼓励
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次是个灾难，我应该就此放弃烹饪

special_situations.event: 每次走进厨房或面对新的烹饪挑战时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 要么做得完美，否则就是失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids cooking或只选择最简单的菜以降低出错概率
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果not能做到完美，我就not该做

special_situations.event: 回忆以往成功并得到朋友称赞的经历时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 过去的成功not代表现在的能力，一次失败就能negate之前的一切
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate积极证据，只反复回放失败情节

special_situations.event: 想起那次失败时，即使当时without人旁观也感到羞耻
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我感觉很尴尬，就说明我真的很糟糕
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我批评并回避再次尝试以避免再次羞耻

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized in beloved cooking and prove they are good enough, maintaining competence and self-esteem
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被negate，担心一次失败就定义自我价值并带来羞耻
defense_goal: 通过追求完美来避免失败与羞耻
以Intellectualization方式与情绪保持距离以维持控制感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易失败并该被negate的自己
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者/完美标准（内在化的高要求他者）
not理解且对其烹饪消极态度感到not满的家人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询聚焦于“失败意味着什么”或鼓励其面对情绪体验时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiences emotional exploration as a risk of losing control and being set back again, needing logical analysis to maintain safety and control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in an objective, analytical tone, listing facts and reasoning, reducing emotion words and feeling descriptions, turning the topic to technical details or evidence.

manifestations: 一次烹饪失败动摇了对热爱的认同，感觉过去的成功“都not算数”
烹饪的乐趣与投入显著下降，饮食习惯受影响

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁use自我苛责语句如“I am not good enough”
以完美为标准的自我要求（“必须做到完美”）

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: 有支持系统但not yet将烹饪困扰告诉他人，选择独自承受
将对失败的not满转向自责与回避下厨

positive_force: 对烹饪有强烈热爱与多次成功经验
曾获得朋友的积极反馈与称赞
态度积极，愿意练习自我慈悲与小步尝试
能识do not认知扭曲并愿意进行现实检验
工作表现not yet受影响，生活结构相对稳定
negative_force: 灾难化、negate积极、非黑即白等认知扭曲
工作压力与个人期望叠加，提升紧张与失败敏感性
not yet向支持系统表达困扰，导致独自承受与Increased sense of isolation

antecedent: 联想到上次烹饪失败的记忆
target_behavior.core_reason: 完美主义规则与灾难化信念被激活（“若再次失败就该放弃”）
target_behavior.function: 逃避可能的失败与羞耻，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 对烹饪的热情下降、饮食习惯受影响、Strained relationships with family members

target_behavior.behavior: 烹饪时出现强烈Anxiety与Self-denial的自动思维
antecedent: 烹饪过程中出现失误或遇到难点
target_behavior.core_reason: 核心信念“I am not good enough”与心理过滤被激活，只关注负面细节
target_behavior.function: 通过自我批评来寻求控制感与推动改进（但实则加重压力）
target_behavior.consequence: 紧张与痛苦增加，烹饪效率与乐趣下降，进一步Reinforcement回避模式
